title: 한국농공학회논문집 2022년 제64권 4호
headline: 서울대학교 연구진이 2편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘Agrivoltaic system (AVS)’, ‘photovoltaic (PV)’, ‘renewable energy · 신재생에너지’, ‘safety assessment · 안전성’, ‘structural design · 구조설계’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 유한요소법, HEC-RAS, 원격탐사.

papers.title: 고랭지밭 밀집지역 초생대의 비점오염 저감 효율 평가 - 비점오염원 관리지역을 중심으로 (만대지구, 가아지구, 자운지구) -
papers.title_en: Efficiency Evaluation of Vegetative Filter Strip for Non-point Source Pollutant at Dense Upland Areas - Focused on Non-point Source Management Area Mandae, Gaa, and Jaun Basins -

summary.result: The results of this study implied that slope and slope length should be considered to find suitable upland conditions for VFS installations.
summary.background: A vegetative filter strip (VFS) is one of the best management practices (BMPs) to reduce pollutant loads.
summary.method: To assess the sediment trapping (STE) and pesticide reduction efficiency (PRE) of VFS, the Vegetative Filter Strip Modeling System (VFSMOD) was applied with three different scenarios (SC) (SC1: VFS with rye vegetation; SC2: VFS with rye vegetation and a gentle slope in VFS range; and SC3: VFS with grass mixture).

papers.title: 농업용 저수지 이수관리를 위한 저수율 가뭄단계기준 개선
papers.title_en: Improvement of Drought Operation Criteria in Agricultural Reservoirs

summary.result: As a result of comparing the current standard and the percentile standard with SPI6, the percentile standard showed severe-level when SPI6 showed severe drought condition, but the current standard fell short of the results.
summary.background: Currently, the operation rule of agricultural reservoirs in case of drought events follows the drought forecast warning standard of agricultural water supply.
summary.method: In this study, we proposed the improvement of drought operation rule for agricultural reservoirs based on the percentile approach using past water level of each reservoir.

papers.title: 한국형 영농형 태양광 스마트팜 시스템의 종합설계 및 구조해석을 통한 안전성 검토
papers.title_en: Integral Design and Structural Analysis for Safety Assessment of Domestic Specialized Agrivoltaic Smart Farm System

summary.result: It is expected that the AVS model will allow for a stable utilization of renewable energy and smart farm technologies in rural areas.
summary.background: Renewable energy systems aim to achieve carbon neutrality and replace fossil fuels.
summary.method: Although several empirical studies on these systems have been conducted, comprehensive research on their design is lacking, and no standard model suitable for South Korea has been developed.

papers.title: AMSR2 위성영상 기반 토양수분을 이용한 우리나라 월별 FDSI 산정 및 공간 분포 특성 분석
papers.title_en: Estimation and Spatial Distribution of Monthly FDSI Using AMSR2 Satellite Image-based Soil Moisture in South Korea

summary.result: The forest regions that have the steep slope degree showed the relatively higher FDSI values than the others.
summary.background: In this study, we estimated the monthly FDSI (Flash Drought Stress Index) for assessing flash drought on South Korea using AMSR2(Advanced Microwave Scanning Radiometer 2) satellite-based soil moisture footprints.
summary.method: Then, the most of regions suffered by flash drought during the periods (July to August) with the high temperature and evapotranspiration.

papers.title: 적설하중 재하실험과 구조해석을 통한 단동 비닐하우스의 거동 연구
papers.title_en: An Experimental and Numerical Study on the Behavior Characteristics of Single-span Plastic Greenhouse under Snow Load

summary.result: Comparing the structural analysis results with the loading test results, the maximum displacement difference is 4.5% and the maximum stress difference is 10.2%.
summary.background: In this study, the loading test and structural analysis were performed on the snow load and the results were compared.
summary.method: The load plates were loaded on the roof surface of the model, and structural analysis was performed under the same conditions.

papers.title: PHABSIM을 이용한 복하천 하류 구간의 피라미 생애주기별 물리적 서식처 평가
papers.title_en: Physical Habitat Assessment of Bokha Downstream Reach Considering Life Cycle Stages of Zacco platypus Using PHABSIM

summary.result: Since the ecological flow rates for juvenile and adult stages appeared to be is greater than the abundant flow rate (3.67 m 3 /s) for the study reach, additional water supply may be needed but should be cautious to avoid the spawning period of Apr through May from the stream water management perspective.
summary.background: The objectives of this study were to assess physical habitat suitability of fish species for different life cycle stages and to suggest appropriate ecological stream flows in a Bokha downstream reach.
summary.method: The hydraulics of flow velocity and depth were used to estimate Weighted Usable Area (WUA) by multiplying respective habitat suitability indices with stream area.

papers.title: 페로니켈 슬래그 잔골재가 혼입된 콘크리트의 강도 평가
papers.title_en: Strength Evaluation of Concrete Containing Ferronickel Slag Aggregate

summary.result: As a result of test, concrete replaced fine aggregate with 25% ferronickel slag aggregate showed superior performance in the compressive strength and flexural strength.
summary.background: For sustainable development in the construction industry, blast furnace slag has been used as a substitute for cement in concrete.
summary.method: Recently, stabilization technology of ferronickel slag has been improved and studies have been carried out to utilize ferronicke slag as fine aggregate in concrete.
